meridians.scope_zh: 肺、胸、喉、上肢內側前緣；主治呼吸系統與咽喉病症。
meridians.scope_en: Lung, chest, throat and the anterior medial arm; respiratory and throat disorders.

meridians.scope_zh: 頭面、口齒、鼻、咽喉、上肢外側前緣；多氣多血。
meridians.scope_en: Head, face, mouth, teeth, nose, throat and the anterior lateral arm.

meridians.scope_zh: 面部、胃腸、下肢外側前緣；多氣多血、主消化與精神。
meridians.scope_en: Face, GI tract and anterior lateral leg; digestion and mental disorders.

meridians.scope_zh: 腹、脾胃、婦科、下肢內側前緣。
meridians.scope_en: Abdomen, spleen–stomach, gynaecology and anterior medial leg.

meridians.scope_zh: 心、胸、神志、上肢內側後緣。
meridians.scope_en: Heart, chest, spirit and posterior medial arm.

meridians.scope_zh: 頭項、耳、目、肩胛、上肢外側後緣。
meridians.scope_en: Head, neck, ear, eye, scapula and posterior lateral arm.

meridians.scope_zh: 頭、項、背腰（背俞穴）、下肢後側；經脈最長。
meridians.scope_en: Head, nape, back (back-shu points) and posterior leg; the longest channel.

meridians.scope_zh: 腎、生殖泌尿、咽喉、下肢內側後緣。
meridians.scope_en: Kidney, urogenital, throat and posterior medial leg.

meridians.scope_zh: 心胸、胃、神志、上肢內側中線。
meridians.scope_en: Heart, chest, stomach, spirit and the midline of the medial arm.

meridians.scope_zh: 側頭、耳、目外眥、肩臂外側中線。
meridians.scope_en: Temporal head, ear, outer canthus and lateral arm midline.

meridians.scope_zh: 側頭、目、耳、脅肋、下肢外側中線。
meridians.scope_en: Temporal head, eye, ear, hypochondrium and lateral leg midline.

meridians.scope_zh: 肝膽、生殖、少腹、下肢內側中線。
meridians.scope_en: Liver–gallbladder, genitals, lower abdomen and medial leg midline.

meridians.scope_zh: 後正中線，總督一身之陽。
前正中線，總任一身之陰。
頭頸、胸腹、背、上肢、下肢的常用奇穴。
meridians.scope_en: Commonly used extra points of the head–neck, trunk, back and limbs.

points.loc_zh: 雲門下1寸，平第1肋間隙，前正中線旁開6寸

points.ind_zh: 咳嗽、氣喘、胸痛、肩背痛
points.ind_en: cough, asthma, chest pain, shoulder-back pain
points.needle: 向外斜刺或平刺0.5–0.8寸；禁深刺（肺）

points.loc_zh: 鎖骨下窩凹陷處，肩胛骨喙突內緣，前正中線旁開6寸
points.loc_en: In the infraclavicular fossa, medial to the coracoid process, 6 cun lateral to the midline
points.ind_zh: 咳嗽、氣喘、胸痛、肩痛
points.ind_en: cough, asthma, chest pain, shoulder pain

points.loc_zh: 腋前紋頭下3寸，肱二頭肌橈側緣
points.loc_en: 3 cun below the anterior axillary fold, radial to the biceps
points.ind_zh: 氣喘、鼻衄、上臂痛

points.loc_zh: 天府下1寸，肱二頭肌橈側緣
points.loc_en: 1 cun below LU3
points.ind_zh: 咳嗽、胸悶、上臂痛

points.loc_zh: 肘橫紋中，肱二頭肌腱橈側凹陷處（合穴）
points.loc_en: In the cubital crease, radial to the biceps tendon (he-sea point)
points.ind_zh: 咳嗽、氣喘、咯血、咽喉腫痛、肘臂攣痛、急性吐瀉
points.ind_en: cough, asthma, haemoptysis, sore throat, elbow pain, acute vomiting/diarrhoea

points.loc_zh: 尺澤與太淵連線上，腕橫紋上7寸（郄穴）
points.loc_en: 7 cun above the wrist crease on the LU5–LU9 line (xi-cleft)
points.ind_zh: 咯血、咳嗽、咽痛、痔血、肘臂痛
points.ind_en: haemoptysis, cough, sore throat, haemorrhoidal bleeding

points.loc_zh: 橈骨莖突上方，腕橫紋上1.5寸（絡穴、八脈交會通任脈）
points.loc_en: Above the radial styloid, 1.5 cun above the wrist crease (luo; confluent with ren mai)

points.ind_en: headache and stiff neck, cough, asthma, sore throat, facial paralysis

points.loc_zh: 橈骨莖突內側，腕橫紋上1寸，橈動脈外側（經穴）
points.loc_en: Medial to the radial styloid, 1 cun above the wrist crease, lateral to the radial artery (jing-river)
points.ind_zh: 咳嗽、氣喘、咽痛、腕痛
points.ind_en: cough, asthma, sore throat, wrist pain

points.loc_zh: 腕掌側橫紋橈側，橈動脈搏動處（輸穴、原穴、脈會）
points.loc_en: At the radial end of the wrist crease on the radial artery (shu-stream, yuan-source, hui of vessels)
points.ind_zh: 咳嗽、氣喘、無脈症、腕痛、咽痛
points.ind_en: cough, asthma, pulseless syndrome, wrist pain

points.loc_zh: 第1掌骨中點橈側赤白肉際（滎穴）
points.loc_en: Midpoint of the 1st metacarpal, radial side, at the junction of red and white skin (ying-spring)
points.ind_zh: 咽喉腫痛、失音、咳嗽、發熱、掌中熱
points.ind_en: sore throat, loss of voice, cough, fever

points.loc_zh: 拇指橈側指甲角旁0.1寸（井穴）
points.loc_en: 0.1 cun from the radial corner of the thumbnail (jing-well)
points.ind_zh: 咽喉腫痛、昏迷、癲狂、高熱、鼻衄
points.ind_en: sore throat, coma, mania, high fever, epistaxis

points.loc_zh: 食指橈側指甲角旁0.1寸（井穴）
points.loc_en: 0.1 cun from the radial corner of the index fingernail (jing-well)
points.ind_zh: 咽喉腫痛、齒痛、耳聾、熱病昏迷
points.ind_en: sore throat, toothache, deafness, febrile coma

points.loc_zh: 微握拳，第2掌指關節前橈側凹陷（滎穴）
points.loc_en: Distal to the 2nd MCP joint on the radial side (ying-spring)
points.ind_zh: 齒痛、咽痛、鼻衄、目痛
points.ind_en: toothache, sore throat, epistaxis, eye pain

points.loc_zh: 第2掌指關節後橈側凹陷（輸穴）
points.loc_en: Proximal to the 2nd MCP joint on the radial side (shu-stream)
points.ind_zh: 齒痛、咽痛、腹脹、手指腫痛

points.loc_zh: 第1、2掌骨間，第2掌骨橈側中點（原穴）

points.ind_zh: 頭痛、齒痛、面癱、咽痛、鼻衄、發熱無汗、經閉、滯產；面口合谷收
points.ind_en: headache, toothache, facial paralysis, sore throat, fever, amenorrhoea, delayed labour; the master point of the face and mouth

points.loc_zh: 腕背橫紋橈側，拇短伸肌腱與拇長伸肌腱之間凹陷（經穴）
points.loc_en: In the anatomical snuffbox at the wrist crease (jing-river)
points.ind_zh: 頭痛、齒痛、目赤、腕痛
points.ind_en: headache, toothache, red eyes, wrist pain

points.loc_zh: 陽溪與曲池連線上，腕橫紋上3寸（絡穴）
points.loc_en: 3 cun above LI5 on the LI5–LI11 line (luo)

points.ind_zh: 腸鳴腹痛、咽痛、面腫、肩臂痛

points.loc_zh: 曲池下4寸
points.loc_en: 4 cun below LI11

points.loc_zh: 曲池下3寸
points.loc_en: 3 cun below LI11
points.ind_zh: 腸鳴腹痛、肩臂麻痛

points.loc_zh: 曲池下2寸
points.loc_en: 2 cun below LI11
points.ind_zh: 齒痛、頰腫、肘臂痛、腹痛泄瀉
points.ind_en: toothache, cheek swelling, elbow pain, diarrhoea

points.loc_zh: 屈肘，肘橫紋外側端與肱骨外上髁連線中點（合穴）
points.loc_en: With the elbow flexed, at the midpoint between the lateral end of the cubital crease and the lateral epicondyle (he-sea)
points.ind_zh: 發熱、咽痛、齒痛、目赤、癮疹、高血壓、肘痛、腹痛吐瀉
points.ind_en: fever, sore throat, toothache, urticaria, hypertension, elbow pain, diarrhoea

points.loc_zh: 曲池外上方1寸，肱骨邊緣

points.ind_zh: 肘臂痛麻

points.loc_zh: 曲池上3寸
points.loc_en: 3 cun above LI11
points.ind_zh: 肘臂痛、瘰癧

points.loc_zh: 曲池上7寸，三角肌止點處
points.loc_en: 7 cun above LI11 at the deltoid insertion

points.loc_zh: 肩峰前下方，上臂外展時肩前凹陷處
points.loc_en: Anteroinferior to the acromion, in the depression when the arm is abducted

points.loc_zh: 鎖骨肩峰端與肩胛岡之間凹陷
points.loc_en: Between the acromial end of the clavicle and the scapular spine
points.ind_zh: 肩臂痛、瘰癧

points.loc_zh: 扶突下1寸，胸鎖乳突肌後緣

points.loc_zh: 鼻翼外緣中點旁，鼻唇溝中

points.needle: 推眼球向上，緊靠眶緣緩慢直刺0.5–1寸；不提插

points.loc_zh: 瞳孔直下，眶下孔凹陷處
points.loc_en: Directly below the pupil in the infraorbital foramen

points.loc_zh: 瞳孔直下，平鼻翼下緣

points.ind_zh: 咽喉腫痛、氣喘、高血壓、瘰癧

points.loc_zh: 人迎與氣舍連線中點

points.loc_zh: 鎖骨內側端上緣，胸鎖乳突肌兩頭之間
points.loc_en: At the upper border of the medial clavicle between the two heads of the SCM

points.loc_zh: 鎖骨上窩中央，前正中線旁4寸

points.loc_en: 1 cun above the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral
